title: Join us on Friday, July 31st, 2026 for our next session of the Public Webinar Series!
bodyHtml:
? Human Reference Atlas: Endothelial Cell Environments Across 12 Organs (47M cells) and Antibody Panel Designer for Spatial Omics Data

? Join this session to hear about recent work that analyzes and visualizes cell-to-nearest-endothelial-cell distance distributions for HuBMAP, SenNet, HTAN, and CZI data; then uses this data and HRA OMAPs to support antibody panel design for future spatial omics studies (https://apps.humanatlas.io/cde/gallery). 

? July 31st, 2026

⏰ 1-2 PM ET

?️ Speakers:

  • Daniel Bolin, Senior Software Developer for the Human Reference Atlas (HRA)
  • Andreas Bueckle, Ph.D., NIH HuBMAP JumpStart Fellow
  • Katy Börner, Ph.D., HRA Lead

? Explore https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02563-5 and HRA Portal at https://humanatlas.io.

Register for the webinar
